ClinicalDocument.title: SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD — Progress Note 5 — Preventive Visit — Jackie Robinson

code.displayName: Periodic reevaluation and management of healthy individual

text.paragraph: Mr. Robinson comes for his yearly preventive visit, nearly four weeks after his four-week review. The heel blister has healed under the podiatrist's care and he wears the fitted shoes. He has had the third eye injections booked for this week. He walks a little farther in the supervised exercise program. He has had no chest pain since metoprolol and no low blood sugar. He says he is still carrying his son's death, that the grief counselor has helped, and that he sleeps better. He asked which screening tests he needs. [S]
Health risk assessment. Read aloud and completed with the nurse before the visit, because he cannot read print, and reviewed with him by Dr. Delacroix-Hale. [S]

Colorectal and prostate screening discussed: he chose a colonoscopy, with written instructions for holding metformin, empagliflozin and part of the insulin dose during the bowel preparation; after discussion of the higher risk of prostate cancer in Black men and of the harms of screening, he chose a PSA test. HIV and hepatitis C screening sent with his agreement. [S]

Follow-up: Third eye injections this week and laser to the right eye in two weeks at the retina clinic. Colonoscopy as arranged. Three-month review in five weeks with the A1c, urine albumin, lipids, kidney function, PHQ-9 and screening results. Next preventive visit in one year. Next scheduled visit 2026-10-26: three-month review: A1c, urine albumin, lipids, eyes after laser treatment, heart, legs, grief, and a GLP-1 receptor agonist. [S]

Voluntary advance care planning discussion of about 20 minutes, with his consent. He wants full treatment for any illness that can be reversed, including heart procedures if they become necessary, and wants plain information about his eyes, heart and legs so that he can decide for himself. He has named a health care agent, recorded in the confidential part of the chart and not named here, and chose not to record other treatment preferences today. To be revisited yearly or after any serious illness. [S]
